set.body:
Objective:
Complete the general analytical relational surface on the independent local engine while preserving the small canonical IR and the typed/runtime schema coherence laws.

Scope:
- Hash group-by with count, sum, mean, variance, minimum, maximum, and explicit empty/null policies.
- Inner and left joins first, with exact key typing, SQL null-key semantics, deterministic collision handling, and correct outer-side nullability.
- Stable explicit sort with declared null placement and order guarantees.
- Union with explicit strict or compatible schema policy, Distinct, and a minimal lawful Window slice sufficient for partitioned aggregate and ranking examples.
- Batch-aware execution that streams when possible and declares buffering or whole-input requirements when not.
- Extension levels: registered portable scalar functions, batch vector kernels, and visibly local optimizer-barrier transforms. Arbitrary row closures are never the primary path.

Acceptance:
- Dynamic and typed APIs construct the same plans and runtime output schemas for every supported operator.
- Independent scalar-loop oracles establish grouped aggregate and join correctness across nulls, NaNs, duplicate keys, empty inputs, multiple chunks, and collision cases.
- Left joins lift right-field nullability in both runtime schema and named-tuple result type.
- using-key joins coalesce only requested equijoin keys; general on joins retain qualified scopes until explicit projection.
- JVM and Scala.js suites pass with deterministic receipts and compile-negative schema tests.
- No operator requires Gale, DuckDB, Spark, ScalaFIM, or row-object materialization.
set.title: Frame foundation 4: grouped aggregation, joins, sort, union, distinct, and windows
